name: 37938 · Knoxville, TN
findings: ZIP 37938 (Knoxville) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37938 (Knoxville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
